Insector War.name: Insector War
Insector War.summary:
Insector War presents a psychedelic, sci-fi take on the FPS genre. Matches are fast-paced, with a simple and direct form of combat: shoot or be shot, using simple and straightforward weapons. Stages are also filled with a variety of obstacles and traps, giving places for players and enemies alike to strafe through and hide from each other in.

In the multiplayer battle mode, Insector War can be played with up to four players in split-screen; it also offers a single-player campaign mode with a simple story.

Super Real Mahjong P.V.name: Super Real Mahjong PV
Super Real Mahjong P.V.summary: Super Real Mahjong P.V is an mahjong video game developed and published by SETA Corporation and released for arcades on November 1994 in Japan only and it is the fifth game of the Super Real Mahjong series.
